import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];
    static long[] totalarea = new long[100];
    static long[] blockarea = new long[100];
    static long[] dp = new long[100];
    static long[] bp = new long[100];
    static long bestfreq = 0;
    static long best = 0;
    static long m1 = 0;
    static long m2 = 0;
    static long n = 0;
    static long R = 0;
    static long C = 0;
    static String str = "";

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextLong();
        C = sc.nextLong();
        str = sc.next();
        n = R + C;
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; b++) {
                if (b > a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 0;
                    continue;
                }
                if (b == 0 || b == a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 1;
                    continue;
                }
                ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
            }
        }
        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[a * n + b] = ncr[a][R - 1] * ncr[b][R - 1];
            }
        }
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a * (n + 1) + b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a * (n + 1) + b] = totalarea[(a - 1) * (n + 1) + b] + totalarea[a * (n + 1) + (b - 1)] - totalarea[(a - 1) * (n + 1) + (b - 1)];
                totalarea[a * (n + 1) + b] += blockarea[(a - 1) * n + (b - 1)];
            }
        }
        int d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 3);
        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                dp[x * (n + 1) + y] = new long[(int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]];
                bp[x * (n + 1) + y] = new long[(int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]];
            }
        }
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;
        bp[0][0][0] = 1;
        best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        m1 = (-best + totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]) / 2;
        m2 = totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n] - m1;
        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'B') {
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]; i++) {
                        if (dp[x][y][i] > 0) {
                            dp[x][y + 1][i] += dp[x][y][i];
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 1) != 'B') {
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]; i++) {
                        if (bp[x][y][i] > 0) {
                            bp[x][y + 1][i] += bp[x][y][i];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (int y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt(x + y) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(x + 1) * (n + 1) + y] - totalarea[x * (n + 1) + y];
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]; i++) {
                        if (dp[x][y][i] > 0) {
                            dp[x + 1][y][i + (int) newarea] += dp[x][y][i];
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt(n - x + n - y - 1) != 'A') {
                    long newarea2 = totalarea[n - x][n - y] - totalarea[n - x - 1][n - y];
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]; i++) {
                        if (bp[x][y][i] > 0) {
                            bp[x + 1][y][i + (int) newarea2] += bp[x][y][i];
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]; i++) {
                        dp[x][y][i] = 0;
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]; i++) {
                        bp[x][y][i] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            int y = (int) (d - x);
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int) totalarea[n * (n + 1) + n]; i++) {
                if (dp[x][y][i] > 0) {
                    bestfreq += dp[x][y][i] * bp[n - x][n - y][(int) m1 - i];
                    if (m1 != m2) {
                        bestfreq += dp[x][y][i] * bp[n - x][n - y][(int) m2 - i];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
